sections.bio:
for the past 4 years I worked as a professional .net developer build multiple startups and now I'm doing odoo

Designed and implemented custom Odoo modules to optimize high-volume inventory and receipt processing for manufacturing workflows

Built performance-focused automation to significantly reduce manual operations and increase warehouse processing speed

Integrated Odoo with external high-performance C# services to handle speed-critical data ingestion and processing

Customized inventory, outgoing, and pallet-based workflows to match real operational constraints

Worked directly with operations and manufacturing teams to translate business processes into stable ERP logic

Improved system reliability by handling edge cases, data consistency, and operational failure scenarios

Ali Mohammadi Nasrabadi 
Amin Rezaei 

That meeting was truly awesome.

I kept reminding myself to take a selfie and share a LinkedIn post about it...

And then I accidentally forgot everything. 😂

So, this is my Plan B.

Thank you, Mr. Rezaei, for generously sharing your knowledge and for taking the time to meet with me.

Thank you, Ali, for inviting me.

One thing I've learned:
A strong circle makes you stronger. 💙

I kept thinking about this:

With the power of AI, is learning still necessary?

My answer is yes.

But what we need to learn has changed.

In this picture, you see three people:

- Me: Learning how senior developers solve problems—and how experienced sales professionals identify problems worth solving.
- Ali Mohammadi: Diving deep into advanced engineering topics.
- Yusof Hosseinpoor: Mastering .NET, software engineering, and software architecture.

Different paths. Same mindset: never stop learning.

AI doesn't replace learning—it changes what gives you an advantage.

Which learning path do you think will matter most in the AI era?

Ali Mohammadi Nasrabadi 
Yousof Hosseinpour
